People Ops: Quick update — power outage planned at the Palo Alto office Tue 8/12 9amnoon for transformer maintenance. Office will be open before/after window but some services (hot coffee, touchscreen kiosks) will be offline during work.
Nate (Facilities): Confirmed  portable battery stations for laptops, extra phone charging packs at reception. Meeting rooms with A/V will be limited 911am.
Hannah: Will badge access still work?
People Ops: Badges work; however turnstiles may be set to manual during the outage. Security will staff entrances.
Ben: I have external candidates onsite at 10am  any guidance?
People Ops: We recommend moving interviews to 8:30am or after 12:30pm. If that's not possible, use the Palo Alto coworking room we booked (details DM). Register guests 24h ahead.
Shuttle Bot: Shuttle note  morning runs unchanged. We added an extra 12:30pm return for folks leaving after the outage.
Riley: Any food/catering changes? Im running a team lunch at noon.
People Ops: Caterer can deliver boxed lunches curbside and we'll distribute after power returns. If you need catering earlier, move to 11:30am. Add dietary needs to the form: https://forms.redwood.ai/pa-power-outage
People Ops: Accessibility note: step-free access unaffected. If you need a quiet area with guaranteed power (medical devices), DM us and we'll reserve a spot with a UPS.
Ben: Thanks  will shift interview times.
People Ops: Final: please mark WFH if you cannot be onsite during the outage. We'll post a short reminder the day before and update this thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
